reporting-org.narrative: European Commission - Directorate-General for International Partnerships

title.narrative: Activity under preparation Partnership for Green Energy Transition in Bangladesh, enhancing energy efficiency and climate action

description.narrative: The action, with an allocation of EUR 5.25 million, focuses on the Global Gateway priority ¿Climate and Energy¿ and aims at further strengthening EU action in the area of the Green Energy Transition in Bangladesh. The action has two mutually complementary components. Both components build on the existing ¿Partnership for Green Energy Transition in Bangladesh¿ project (AAP 2022, implemented by GIZ).The first component will further strengthen the work on enhanced energy efficiency, advancing the policy dialogue on the definition and implementation of sectoral and national energy efficiency targets, which are essential for future investments in energy efficiency, thus supporting the achievement of Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 7 on Affordable and Clean Energy.The second component aims at further strengthening the Team Europe Initiative (TEI) on Climate and Energy, broadening the policy dialogue on energy under the ¿Partnership for Green Energy Transition in Bangladesh¿ project to a broader dialogue on climate and energy, including the climate targets. By fostering more ambitious and long-term strategies and sharing European expertise and best practices, the dialogue will enhance the enabling environment for investment and deepen engagement between the European and Bangladeshi private sectors. This component will thus also support SDG 7 on energy, as well as advance progress towards SDG 13: Climate Action - Take urgent action to combat climate change and its impacts. The action will also cover important key markers such as the Rio markers (climate change mitigation, climate change adaptation), the Gender Equality Marker, and other markers related to good governance, climate induced migration, and digitalisation. The action intends to contribute to both specific objectives under the MIP 2021-27 Priority Area 2 - Green Inclusive Development, i.e. Specific Objective 1 ¿to promote energy efficiency and affordable renewable energy¿ and Specific Objective 2 ¿to improve environmental protection and support climate change mitigation and adaptation in Bangladesh¿s sustainable development¿.
